source_text: In this vein, sanitarian John Harvey Kellogg's 1881 treatise Plain Facts for Old and Young endorsed circumcision without anesthesia for boys to discourage masturbation—seen as a source of moral and physical decline—while promoting genital hygiene through the procedure's pain as a deterrent. [157]
